name: How much does it cost to build a detached ADU in Los Angeles?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to build a detached ADU in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to build a detached ADU in Los Angeles can vary significantly based on factors like size, finishes, site conditions, and specific design choices. Typical costs can range from $150,000 to over $300,000. This includes design, permits, materials, and construction labor. A detailed quote requires an assessment of your property and specific project requirements. We provide transparent estimates after an initial consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs for a detached ADU in Los Angeles vary widely, typically from $150,000 to $300,000+, depending on size, finishes, and site conditions.
